research_question: How does intervention strength trade off causal utility, damage, and image-source specificity at matched trajectory checkpoints?
hypothesis: Intermediate contraction strengths preserve true-image utility while reducing harmful trajectory displacement; source-specific gains should exceed nonvisual controls.
baseline: matched hard branch at the same sample and checkpoint
success_gate: At least one intermediate lambda improves the pooled utility-risk frontier over lambda 0.95 or reveals a reproducible source-specific dose response.
stop_rule: Do not tune further if utility and damage are source-invariant across the full 0.20-1.00 curve or if apparent gains do not replicate across checkpoints and datasets.
